items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I say, "John, I ain't gonna audition for no (inaudible) job like that.

ctx.x: So John Hammond say, "Okay, I want you to -- I'll call you. I want you to come in the staff."
I say, "John, I ain't gonna audition for no (inaudible) job like that. Why should I (inaudible) audition for. Ain't nothing but orchestrations over there."
"Those little arrangements yall playing (inaudible) commercial things, you know. Everybody been playing them."
